title: Dot portal into a grain-wave brand reveal
summary: A one-word hook on cream whose letter dot opens into a dark scene with a drifting grainy green wave; short serif lines blur in, the mark grows, a dashboard pulls out to full view, then a typed URL and a mark hold close it.
use_when: A calm launch for a web app with one dashboard screenshot worth showing
Brand reveal where the mark and a two-tone name carry the middle of the film
A serif, premium voice with music only and no voice-over
Closing on a typed URL and a quiet mark hold

look.type_style: bold transitional serif, sentence case, normal tracking; hook word ~14 % H, lines ~4 % H, split pair ~7 % H, URL ~3 % H; name two-tone (second half in the green accent)

sfx.event: dot opens into the dark scene at 0.93 s
mark grows and glows at 3.00-3.77 s

structure.shot: one short word, centred black serif on flat cream; one letter is a solid black dot
structure.camera: push-in: word width grows ~1.00 -> 1.15 from 0.00 to 0.77 s, then blurs at 0.90 s
structure.motion: word scales up on easings.inOutSine ~28 fr (±0.25 s); last ~3 fr motion blur; the dot becomes a disc mask that opens into the next scene

structure.shot: dark ground, wide grainy green wave band drifting; centred serif line, 4 words, names the finished chore
structure.camera: drift: wave band travels and changes phase, text fixed
structure.motion: disc mask expands from the dot to full frame by 1.00 s; line blur-in, easings.outExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s), sharp at 1.27 s; holds; blur-out before 2.00 s

structure.shot: same wave; intro line, 2 words: verb + product name, second half of the name in the green accent
structure.motion: whole line blur-in from 2.00 s, sharp at 2.27 s (easings.outExpo ~8 fr, ±0.25 s); holds to ~2.85 s; blur-out

structure.shot: the brand mark (thin line icon) alone on the wave
structure.camera: push-in on the mark: height ~0.9x -> 1.9x of the 3.00 s size by 3.77 s
structure.motion: mark scales up on springs.heavy ~23 fr (overshoot not measurable), line strokes thicken into a filled white glyph with glow at 3.77 s; vanishes by 4.00 s

structure.shot: wave only, then the two-tone name returns upper centre and dissolves into a 4-word capability line built word by word
structure.camera: drift: wave band rises and flattens; line moves from upper third to centre between 4.77 and 5.00 s
structure.motion: name blur-in at 4.27 s; at 4.50 s name crossfades into the first word; words appended one per ~0.25 s (4.77, 5.00, 5.27, 5.50 s), each blur-in easings.outExpo ~6 fr (±0.25 s); line re-centres on springs.ui; soft white glow grows behind it to 6.27 s

structure.shot: a tilted dark document card lands centre; two large serif words appear left and right of it, then the card flies up and out
structure.motion: card enters tilted ~-15 deg at 6.50 s (springs.pop, overshoot not measurable); pair of words blur-in at 6.77 s around it; card rotates and exits to the top 7.00-7.50 s on easings.inExpo ~12 fr (±0.25 s); words hold then fade by 7.77 s

structure.shot: product dashboard close-up, cropped top-left: greeting header, 4 stat tiles, a list of flagged rows
structure.camera: detail tier, slow drift right/up; from 9.27 s a fast pull-out with motion blur (~-30 %/s zoom in motion.json 9-10 s)
structure.motion: dashboard appears ~7.87 s (between cells, ±0.25 s); pull-out on springs.cameraOut ~15 fr (±0.25 s) with rows smearing at 9.50 s

structure.shot: full dashboard inside a dark rounded window over the green wave, side nav, header, stat tiles, lists
structure.camera: full tier, settled by 9.77 s; slight drift; from 11.00 s the window slides up (~51 px/s @1920 in motion.json 11-12 s)
structure.motion: window settles springs.cameraOut (overshoot not measurable); hold ~1.2 s; exits upward and is gone by 11.50 s (easings.inExpo, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: wave only, then the site URL typed in small white serif, centred, then held
structure.motion: typewriter from 11.77 s, ~16 chars over ~1.0 s (~16 cps), complete by 12.77 s; holds 1.0 s; cut away near 13.90 s (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the brand mark small and white, centred in the dip of the wave, held to the end
structure.camera: drift: wave band only; mark lands from ~1.6x to 1.0x between 14.00 and 14.27 s
structure.motion: mark arrives large and settles on springs.snappy ~8 fr (overshoot not measurable); hold 1.7 s while the wave keeps moving

params.brand: brand.json: display serif, cream light bg for the hook, near-black bg, green accent for the wave and the name's second half
params.content.hookWord: one short word with a round letter that becomes the portal dot
params.content.problem: line, ~4 words, the chore the user just finished or faces
params.content.intro: 2 words: verb + product name (name may be two-tone)
params.content.capability: line, ~4 words, built word by word
params.content.pair: 2 words split around a document card
params.content.screenshot: one dashboard image, 1512x982 or larger, with a readable top-left region
params.timing.bpm: music tempo; rows ~1 s each in the first 4 s

notes: One cut only (0.93 s, cuts.json): the letter dot of the hook word opens as a disc into the dark scene; the detector flags it as a hard cut in motion. Everything after is one continuous shot over a grainy green sine band (grain wave background not in the vocabulary, see recipe.md Proposed terms). Entrances, springs and stagger are below the 4 fps sheet resolution and are suggested defaults (±0.25 s). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured: the reference is music only (118.9 BPM, -17.2 LUFS, no VO). cut_on_beat 0/1.
